cues: A closed end is a displacement node, an open end an antinode.
A closed pipe gives only odd harmonics of v over four L.
An open pipe gives all harmonics of v over two L, an octave higher.
The end correction is zero point six r, and the resonance tube cancels it: v equals two f, l two minus l one.
On a string, v is root T over mu, every harmonic is allowed, and the frequency goes as one over L, root T, and one over root mu.
text: Let us recap. A closed end is a displacement node, an open end an antinode. A closed pipe gives only odd harmonics of v over four L. An open pipe gives all harmonics of v over two L, an octave higher. The end correction is zero point six r, and the resonance tube cancels it: v equals two f, l two minus l one. On a string, v is root T over mu, every harmonic is allowed, and the frequency goes as one over L, root T, and one over root mu.
